compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays a permission request dialog. The dialog is asking the user whether to allow an application named "Bob Marley" to access photos, media, and files on the device. The user is given two options: "DENY" or "ALLOW." The dialog also indicates that this is the first of two permission requests. The background is grey, and the status bar at the top shows various icons and the time, which is 11:41.
